title: mitmweb CLI startup and Tornado server initialization callpath
answers: How does mitmweb start up the Tornado web server?
What is the control flow from CLI to WebMaster in mitmweb?
Where does mitmweb initialize HTTP and WebSocket handlers?
body:
Control flow from the mitmweb command line invocation to listening HTTP/WebSocket server:
1. `mitmproxy/tools/main.py:mitmweb` calls `run(web.master.WebMaster, cmdline.mitmweb, args)`.
2. `mitmproxy/tools/cmdline.py:mitmweb` sets up CLI flags and registers options via `WebAddon`.
3. `mitmproxy/tools/web/master.py:WebMaster.__init__` registers `mitmproxy/tools/web/webaddons.py:WebAddon` into the addon manager.
4. `mitmproxy/tools/web/master.py:WebMaster.run` instantiates `mitmproxy/tools/web/app.py:Application`, binds `tornado.httpserver.HTTPServer` to `options.web_host`/`options.web_port`, and starts the IOLoop.
5. `mitmproxy/tools/web/webaddons.py:WebAddon.running` triggers browser launch via `webbrowser.open` when `options.web_open_browser` is true.
